gaps.description: GET /tasks has no query parameter filtering. list_tasks() in app/routers/tasks.py accepts no parameters; all tasks are always returned regardless of status, priority, or title substring.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add Optional query params status, priority, and q to list_tasks(). Extend the SQL query with WHERE clauses for status and priority (exact match) and LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER('%q%') for title. Also add corresponding tests in tests/test_tasks.py.

gaps.description: test_update_task only verifies a happy-path status update. Missing: invalid status value, invalid priority value, and 404 for a non-existent task_id.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add test_update_task_invalid_status, test_update_task_invalid_priority, and test_update_task_not_found in tests/test_tasks.py asserting correct HTTP error codes (422 and 404).

gaps.description: test_delete_task only verifies the 204 happy path. The requirement mandates a 404 when deleting a non-existent task, which has no test coverage.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add tests/test_tasks.py::test_delete_task_not_found calling DELETE /tasks/9999 and asserting status_code == 404.

gaps.description: No test exercises the name length constraint (1-100 chars). Sending an empty name or a 101-char name should be rejected, but is untested.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add test_create_user_empty_name and test_create_user_name_too_long in tests/test_users.py asserting 422 responses.

gaps.description: GET /users has no test coverage at all.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add tests/test_users.py::test_list_users that creates one or more users, calls GET /users, and asserts status 200 and correct list contents.

gaps.description: POST /tasks/{id}/assign has zero test coverage. The happy path and both 404 branches (unknown task, unknown user) are all untested.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add test_assign_task (happy path), test_assign_task_task_not_found, and test_assign_task_user_not_found in tests/test_tasks.py.

gaps.description: Title validation (required, whitespace-trimming, max 100 chars) has no test coverage despite validate_title() being called on create and update.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add test_create_task_empty_title, test_create_task_whitespace_title, and test_create_task_title_too_long in tests/test_tasks.py asserting 422/400 responses.

gaps.description: due_date future-date validation has no test coverage. No test passes a past date to POST /tasks or PATCH /tasks/{id} to verify rejection.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add tests/test_tasks.py::test_create_task_past_due_date submitting a past ISO date and asserting a 422/400 response.

gaps.description: No tests exist for GET /tasks filtering. Even once the feature is implemented, there are no tests to guard it.
gaps.fix_suggestion: After implementing R-11, add test_filter_by_status, test_filter_by_priority, test_filter_by_q, and test_combined_filters in tests/test_tasks.py.

gaps.description: GET /tasks/stats is implemented but has zero test coverage. Grouped counts and total are never verified.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Add tests/test_tasks.py::test_get_stats that creates tasks with various statuses and asserts the correct per-status counts and total.

gaps.description: test_list_tasks only checks list length (1 item); it does not assert any field values on the returned task object.
gaps.fix_suggestion: Extend test_list_tasks to assert resp.json()[0]['title'] == 'Task A' and other key fields for field-level coverage.
